input.question: Does mixed-precision training change final accuracy of small CNNs?

sources.S1: We find fp16 mixed precision matches fp32 accuracy within 0.1% on CIFAR-10 when loss scaling is used.
sources.S2: Without loss scaling, fp16 training diverged in 3 of 10 runs.
sources.S3: Mixed precision reduced training time by 1.6x on V100 GPUs.

input.question: Is early stopping sensitive to validation split size?

sources.A: Validation sets below 5% of data produced high-variance stopping epochs.
sources.B: Patience of 10 epochs was robust across tasks.
sources.C: Early stopping on test data inflates reported accuracy.

input.question: What limits simulated annealing on Rastrigin?

sources.R1: Cooling schedules that are too fast trap annealing in local minima on Rastrigin.
sources.R2: Restarts improved best-found values by 30% at equal evaluation budget.
sources.R3: Step size adaptation matters more than initial temperature in 10 dimensions.
